notes.title: Updated [ver1.0.3]
notes.content:
Update contents:
* Adjusted the random number processing.
* Changed so that you can cancel Chii/Pon/Kan, etc. with just a right click.
  + The "Next" screen transition can now be performed by right-clicking only.

tags.feature: * Changed so that you can cancel Chii/Pon/Kan, etc. with just a right click.
+ The "Next" screen transition can now be performed by right-clicking only.

notes.title: Updated [ver1.0.2]
notes.content:
Update contents:
* The function of meld off was changed to reset in round.
* Added English "romaji yaku" display.
* Added multiplayer records.
* Changed the multiplayer rules to "Win End".[Agari yame]
* Added a timer on/off setting in multiplayer friend matches.
* Fixed to release the lobby if the lobby owner leaves the room by matching.
* Added support for resolution change.
* A display guide for "winning" tiles was added.
* Other minor modifications.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302682/5bb6c53ba9efd927c4cbf271827717cdbd941a76.png[/img]

notes.title: Updated [ver1.0.1]
notes.content:
Update contents:
* Added support for automatic discard after riichi.
* Added meld off function.
* Changed Chow/Pung/Kong to Chii/Pon/Kan in the English setting.
* A numbered tile was added. You can change them in the settings.
* Other minor modifications.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302682/8bc3b6d6b4b208e0bc116cd5cca9c7f2c2bfd032.png[/img]
